facts.statement: Player FSM loader flattens LinkMotion into destination-owned connection entries. Generic VM drive +0x30 is not the demonstrated player exit path.

ActionNo is translated through weapon/common native identity tables. Destination lookup uses first mapped pair; source emits each mapped pair. The weapon default set also emits the group-1 broadcast list for Phase0.
First exact previous group/id and PlMotionCommon+0x10c phase match. Signed-negative connector IDs are omitted. No match starts main directly, no Phase1 fallback.
Action phase0 waits for player virtual+0x2b0, then calls main start. Predicate reads layer flags &5, with optional player additional-end path; not an arbitrary duration or generic drive timer.

Player common object registered with motion TIML container. Motion binding dirty path reaches timeline rebind, reset-all invokes parameter virtual+0x28, PlMotionCommon zeroes +0x10c before evaluating new binding. Missing track after this reset stays0; constructor alone is not proof.

Motion request consumer selects by target/source motion, source bank and optional source-frame limit, retaining record order. Runtime row+0x28 is converted to request+0x18 as start frame. Other fields are retained raw; UE blend equivalence is not proven.
